offering_description.value: Owns and operates radio stations and the iHeartRadio digital audio platform, selling advertising and sponsorships to brands and agencies. Also produces podcasts and live events for listeners and advertisers across the United States.

primary_products.value: radio stations; iHeartRadio app; podcasts; live events

primary_services.value: advertising sales; digital marketing; live event production; podcast production

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, brands and advertising agencies; B2C: listeners using radio, the iHeartRadio app and podcasts

revenue_model.value: advertising: spot and sponsorship sales to brands and agencies; subscription: paid subscription tiers of the iHeartRadio app; other: ticketed live events and event sponsorships

value_chain_position.value: service provider: radio broadcasting and content production, sold as advertising to brands; software / platform: iHeartRadio streaming app and platform, offered to listeners and advertisers

geography_served.value: US national: radio stations in many US markets plus national digital and podcast audiences

specialization.value: related lines: radio, digital audio streaming, podcasts and live events sharing advertisers and audiences

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: national and local sales teams selling to advertisers and agencies; online: iHeartRadio app and website for listeners; other: over-the-air broadcast, smart speakers and car dashboards reaching listeners

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FCC licenses for broadcast radio stations, copyright royalty rules and data privacy laws
